[image: Bert Mizusawa avatar]Bert Mizusawa@GenBert2026·Oct 13Happy Birthday to the United States Navy! For 251 years, and through numerous wars and conflicts to this day, America’s Sailors have defended us and braved numerous challenges to keep our vital sea routes open and secure. To every Sailor, past and present, and their families and survivors who supported their service and sacrifice: thank you for the steadfast and intrepid support of our great maritime nation. Fair winds and following seas.

[image: Bert Mizusawa avatar]Bert Mizusawa@GenBert2026·Oct 13Mark Warner used a 51% childhood food insecurity claim to advance a political narrative about the White House ballroom. Yet the report behind that figure won’t release its full methodology until 2027. The USDA’s data puts Virginia’s household food insecurity rate at about 13%, a very different picture. These statistics deserve scrutiny, not political spin. Fighting childhood hunger should be about feeding hungry children, not using them as political talking points. Virginians deserve transparency and facts. https://restoration-news.com/warner-s-childhood-hunger-hoax-exposed

[image: Bert Mizusawa avatar]Bert Mizusawa@GenBert2026·Oct 13Senator, you’ve had 17 years. Costs are higher, not lower. You voted for massive spending packages that drove inflation and piled on trillions in debt. On your watch, Virginia became the world's data center capital, and those facilities are now driving up electricity rates for families across the state. Housing remains out of reach for too many Virginians. Promises aren’t results. Your time is up. This November, you’re fired.
